local_anchor.role: canonical custody, Git history, private route state, manifests, approval and import review

cloud_compute.role: ephemeral or managed execution of explicitly admitted sanitized capsules
cloud_compute.filesystem_assumption: Linux cloud paths are distinct from Windows D paths
prohibited_claims: independent reproduction without independent team and methods

exchange.outbound: sanitized immutable manifest plus allowed files and requested operations
exchange.inbound: quarantined result manifest, checks, environment receipt, failures and output digests
exchange.promotion: local digest replay, policy checks, review, explicit import decision and normal Git lifecycle
exchange.identity: capsule digest, not task identity or relational name

strongest_objection: A file-exchange layer can become a shadow deployment pipeline if imports, credentials, costs, and authority are not separately governed.
response: Make transfer one-way per capsule, keep secrets out, require expiry and cost ceilings, quarantine returns, and prohibit direct cloud-to-canonical promotion.
rejected_options: shared mutable filesystem between Windows local and managed cloud
cloud task as canonical memory or identity store
UI automation of the Codex desktop
